## Problem

Describe what failed and what you expected.

## Reproduction

1. Start from an isolated test instance.
2. Describe the smallest steps that reproduce the problem.
3. Include the result or redacted error text.

## Environment

- Application version or commit:
- OS and architecture:
- Installation method:
- Go / Node.js versions, if building:
- Browser and interface language:
- Deployment mode (local / HTTPS proxy):

## Evidence

Include relevant redacted logs or synthetic screenshots. Never attach a database, backup, cookie, API key, enrollment token or Agent configuration.

## Checks

- [ ] I checked the current guide, SUPPORT.md and existing issues.
- [ ] I can reproduce this without sharing production data or credentials.
